summary: Tested new 4-feature batch: Site Builder, Stripe Terminal (simulated), Property Presets, AI Copilot. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass. Frontend: sidebar renders, AI Copilot panel (gradient header, 3 stats, 8 module cards, price-guards navigation works), Site Builder saves draft + publishes modern template, Terminal adds simulated reader + charges £15 with succeeded log entry, Presets panel shows 5 cards, My tasks item present, Regression OK. Public /site/default renders correctly with modern template and CTA to /book/default. Left site PUBLISHED with template='modern' and headline='Şehrin kalbinde konfor' as required.

minor.issue: No validation of content field types (accepts amenities as list or string). Frontend HotelSitePage.js calls .split() on amenities so a non-string breaks the public page. Recommend coercing to string or validating shape.

ui_bugs.issue: (c.amenities || "").split(...) throws 'split is not a function' if amenities stored as non-string (array). Reproduced with amenities: [] payload — public page shows generic error boundary. Add Array.isArray branch or coerce.

action_items: HotelSitePage.js: make amenities parsing tolerant of both string and array (typeof === 'string' ? split : Array.isArray ? use directly). Same for backend content validation with Pydantic model.
critical_code_review_comments: Site builder saves free-form dict — no Pydantic model, so type drift possible. Add strict schema.
Terminal charge relies on reader_id.startswith('tmr_') to detect simulated; brittle. Query reader from Stripe or track in DB.
AI Copilot summary counts collections queried with property_id filter but some collections may not have property_id — verify indexes exist for perf.
seed_data_creation: Test creates & cleans up TEST_scratch_* property + room_types + rms_setup for preset apply test. Also leaves /site/default published with template='modern' + headline='Şehrin kalbinde konfor' as required by test spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is currently published (modern template). Simulated Stripe reader(s) exist under /api/terminal/default/readers. If future tests need clean state, unpublish site or delete tmr_* readers. Amenities in stored content is a comma-separated string.
rca of the issue: Frontend crash on /site/{pid} reproduced when content.amenities is stored as an array by any client (e.g., via API/curl). Root cause: HotelSitePage.js line 28 does '(c.amenities || "").split(",")' — .split is undefined on arrays. Mitigation: `const amenities = Array.isArray(c.amenities) ? c.amenities : (c.amenities || "").split(",").map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);` — or normalize in backend.
